name: B2B Quantity Manager for WooCommerce
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Conditional Quantity Manager for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the professional-grade solution for store owners who need granular control over product purchase quantities. Whether you sell in bulk, items by weight, or items that must be bought in specific sets, this plugin provides the flexibility you need.

Replicating high-end functionality in a sleek, free package, our manager ensures your customers follow your business rules—reducing order errors and streamlining your fulfillment process.

Key Features

  • Product-Level Limits: Enforce specific Minimum and Maximum quantity requirements for individual items.
  • Flexible Step Increments: Force purchases in specific increments (e.g., pairs of 2, packs of 6, or crates of 12).
  • Decimal Quantity Support: Enable precise sales for weight-based products (e.g., 0.5kg, 1.25kg) with built-in validation.
  • Quantity Dropdown UI: Replace standard number inputs with an elegant, user-friendly dropdown menu.
  • User Role Restrictions: Apply different rules for different customer segments (e.g., Wholesale vs. Retail).
  • Category-Level Rules: Set bulk quantity restrictions for entire product categories instantly.
  • Store-Wide Cart Restrictions: Enforce total cart quantity or subtotal amount limits before checkout.
  • Modern Admin Interface: A blazing fast, React-powered settings dashboard to manage all your global rules in one place.

Perfect For

  • Wholesale Stores: Require minimum order quantities (MOQ) for bulk pricing or specific user roles.
  • Grocery & Fresh Produce: Sell items by weight using decimal steps (e.g., meat, vegetables, or spices).
  • Boutique Retailers: Sell items that must be bought in pairs or sets (e.g., wine bottles, tiles, or event tickets).
  • Manufacturing: Ensure orders match your batch sizes or packaging constraints.

Why Choose VerseSofts?

The default WooCommerce quantity field is often too basic for complex business models. By using Conditional Quantity Manager, you can:
1. Reduce Manual Refunds: Prevent customers from ordering quantities you can’t fulfill.
2. Optimize Shipping: Ensure orders fit your packaging sizes perfectly.
3. Increase Average Order Value: Encourage bulk purchases through minimum quantity requirements.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Conditional Quantity Manager for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Conditional Quantity Manager to configure your rules.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the conditional-quantity-manager-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does it support decimal quantities?

Yes! You can set steps like 0.1 or 0.5 and the plugin will validate the math precisely on the frontend and backend.

Can I restrict rules to specific user roles?

Absolutely. Every rule (Product, Category, or Global) can be targeted to specific user roles or applied to all customers.

Which rule takes priority?

The hierarchy is built to provide maximum flexibility: Individual Product Rules > Category Rules > Global Rules.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, it is fully compatible with both the standard Cart/Checkout shortcodes and the modern WooCommerce Blocks.
